title: Core procs validate_set_emphasis/apply_set_emphasis keep the retired word while the command is Cmd_Set_Weights — sweep gap, not deliberate
evidence: core/topology.odin:385 "// validate_set_emphasis — the weight-set command (5.8 payload; user ruling"; core/topology.odin:395 "validate_set_emphasis :: proc(t: ^Topology, c: Cmd_Set_Weights, cat: ^Catalogs) -> Edit_Error {"; core/topology.odin:412 "// apply_set_emphasis — assumes validate_set_emphasis returned .None. Replaces"; core/topology.odin:417 "apply_set_emphasis :: proc(t: ^Topology, c: Cmd_Set_Weights, cat: ^Catalogs) {"; core/topology.odin:483 "		if e := validate_set_emphasis(t, c, cat); e != .None { return {}, e }"; core/topology.odin:484 "		apply_set_emphasis(t, c, cat)"; core/types.odin:63 "	Cmd_Set_Weights,"; core/serialize.odin:56 "CMD_TAG_SET_WEIGHTS :: u8(5)  // 3.2 — set a pipe's lane-weight preset (the dial)"
detail: The sweep renamed the union variant, tag constant, and even these procs' doc comments, but left the two core proc names (and their call sites) with the retired word. Audit scope column ('one union variant + comments') and canon discipline cover non-serialized identifiers; no keep-ruling exists in the decision-log — an oversight.
recommended_fix: Rename to validate_set_weights/apply_set_weights, update the two call sites at core/topology.odin:483-484 and the doc comments; no serialized or behavioral impact.
